summary: Iteration 54 — Inventory (İnventar) module: backend pytest (13/13 passed) covering CRUD, auto display_id (I###), 400-validation on empty asset_name, 404 on unknown id, value-report aggregations and RBAC (admin write OK; sales-manager blocked from write with 403). Frontend Playwright end-to-end smoke: Finance → tab-inventory → sub-tab list/report navigation, Add modal create, Edit pre-fill + update, search filter, delete-with-confirm, Excel export click — all green; no console errors.

issues: Radix Dialog console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent'. Cosmetic a11y warning, not blocking. Add DialogDescription or aria-describedby to silence.

action_items: (Optional, a11y polish) Add <DialogDescription> (or aria-describedby) to InventoryTab.jsx DialogContent to remove Radix console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Auto display_id is based on count_documents() — non-atomic; if two creates land in the same millisecond the same I### could be generated. For low-volume admin module this is acceptable, but consider an atomic counter (findOneAndUpdate $inc on a sequence doc) for safety.

PUT /api/finance/inventory/{id} silently accepts unknown extra keys (only whitelisted fields are persisted) — fine, but no body validation via Pydantic model; consider promoting `data: dict` to a typed InventoryUpdate model for clarity and stricter input handling.
Frontend InventoryTab.jsx is ~583 lines — borderline. Splitting modal form into its own component would improve maintainability if more fields are added later.
InventoryTab handleDelete uses window.confirm; consider migrating to the shared shadcn AlertDialog pattern used elsewhere in the app for consistency.
MongoDB _id correctly excluded everywhere (find({..}, {'_id': 0}) and explicit pop after insert). Good.
